therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: systemic iron burden reduction / cardiac iron clearance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with transfusional iron overload and cardiac iron overload (myocardial T2* 6–20 ms)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in myocardial T2* (geometric mean ratio) after 12 months

results.effect_size: Geometric mean ratio of T2* at 12 months: deferasirox 1.12 (95% CI 1.07–1.18) vs deferoxamine 1.07 (95% CI 1.02–1.11); non-inferiority demonstrated
results.target_engagement_evidence: Cardiac iron concentration (derived from T2*) decreased in both arms; deferasirox AUCtau 2129.70 h·ng/mL, Cmax 150.09 µmol/L at 40 mg/kg/day
biomarker_changes: Myocardial T2* geometric mean ratio at 12 months: deferasirox 1.12, deferoxamine 1.07
Cardiac iron concentration change at 24 months (extension ICL-to-ICL): −0.70 mg Fe/g dw
Liver iron concentration change at 24 months (extension ICL-to-ICL): −15.74 mg Fe/g dw; DFO-to-DFO: −26.02 mg Fe/g dw
Serum ferritin change at 24 months (extension ICL-to-ICL): −2239.03 µg/L; DFO-to-DFO: −2724.00 µg/L
LVEF change at 12 months: deferasirox −0.5%, deferoxamine −0.0%
subgroup_findings: Extension ICL-to-ICL T2* ratio at 24 months: 1.38 (95% CI 1.28–1.49)
Extension DFO-to-DFO T2* ratio at 24 months: 1.33 (95% CI 1.13–1.55)
Extension DFO-to-ICL T2* ratio at 24 months: 1.21 (95% CI 1.09–1.34)
DFO arm showed greater liver iron concentration reduction than deferasirox arm throughout extension
3 deferasirox patients vs 2 deferoxamine patients withdrew due to cardiac dysfunction criteria
safety_signals: At least one AE: deferasirox 65/96 patients, deferoxamine 69/91 patients
Serious AEs: 10 in each arm during core phase
1 death in each arm (none considered drug-related)
Gastrointestinal SAEs (abdominal pain, colitis, gastric haemorrhage, duodenal ulcer haemorrhage) reported in deferasirox arm

dose_info.schedule: Deferasirox: once daily; Deferoxamine: 8–12 hour subcutaneous infusion 5–7 days/week
dose_info.dose_modifications: Deferasirox dose escalated: 20 mg/kg/day for 2 weeks, then 30 mg/kg/day for 1 week, then 40 mg/kg/day continuation

context.indication: Transfusional iron overload with cardiac iron overload
context.duration: 12 months core study; up to 24 months with extension
